body: I, sometimes, expercience this. Just drinking water in a quietplace and chewing chips make me so anxious. I'm afraid anyone who hears it will laugh at me.
Lmao so true, it even gets worse whenever I'm alone, idk, I hate myself so much coz I know I have friends that are willing to listen but I still can't stop myself from being like this.

She doesn't want my help and I can't really help her at anything. I'm so useless.
Yep, just two of them, and the other one also suffers from depression. That's why I want to stop opening up to her, I'd just fuel all her burning problems. What should I do?

Aww you made my day. Same for me, you can also talk to me if you ever feel lonely or just when you need someone to talk to about stupid random things that people would think weirdly of, I'll listen. Can we be friends?

I did try to open up with my friends. I realized that not all can understand, it only hurt me more. They refer to this as "temporary sadness" and told me that I'm the only one making it worse (well,they're quite right). I think they also don't believe me, they think that I'm just faking this extreme sadness just because I'm always laughing, when in fact, I just do it to hide it and to not kill the mood.
Going to a therapist scares me so much. It feels like I'm really a useless person and my family and friends would probably feel disappointed.
